label: The time-indexed formulation
subgoals: Create one binary variable per operation per step of its frame
Sum the frame widths to count the variables
Write each start time as the step-weighted sum of its variables

label: Constraints and objective
subgoals: Add one unique-start constraint per operation
Add one precedence constraint per dependence edge
Add one resource constraint per step per unit type

label: The SDC formulation
subgoals: Use one integer start variable per operation
Write dependences, latency and chaining limits as difference constraints
Solve the LP and rely on total unimodularity for an integer schedule
